people.name: Phinehas
people.line: Aaron's grandson; zealous priest who opposed idolatry

translations.web: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
translations.bsb: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
translations.kjv: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
translations.asv: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment; And so the plague was stayed.
